Set the $SIMULATION record of a NONMEM control stream

set_simulation_record.Rd

Works on the model code rather than on a Pharmpy model object, because Pharmpy cannot parse TRUE=PRIOR (see set_simulation_clean()) and because the uncertainty_engine = "nwpri" path of run_sim() only varies the seed and the subproblem count between chunks — a string edit on an otherwise finished control stream.

Usage

set_simulation_record(code, seed, n, true_prior = FALSE)

Arguments

code

NONMEM model code (single string or character vector of lines).

seed

random seed number

n

number of simulation subproblems to run

true_prior

emit TRUE=PRIOR, i.e. have NONMEM draw a new parameter vector from the model's $PRIOR record for every subproblem (see add_nwpri_prior()). Default FALSE.

Value

NONMEM model code as a single string.

Details

An existing $SIMULATION record is replaced in place, so its position relative to the $TABLE records is preserved. When the model has none, the record is appended.
